description: A vulnerability was identified in itsourcecode Online Book Store 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /admin_edit.php. The manipulation of the argument bookisbn leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.
